faq.question: Can I submit work that has been published elsewhere?
faq.answer: Please check the main conference's policy on dual submissions. Generally, work that has been published in archival venues is not allowed.

faq.question: What is the page limit for submissions?
faq.answer: The page limit is 8 pages excluding references. Supplementary materials are optional.

faq.question: Is the review process double-blind?
faq.answer: Yes, all submissions must be anonymized for double-blind review.
